name: Chop insight
threading: Pure functions; thread-safe; run on a worker thread. Not real-time safe.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/chop_insight -B build/chop_insight && cmake --build build/chop_insight && ctest --test-dir build/chop_insight
summary: Deterministic, model-free audio analysis for Smart Setup: per-chop spectral balance, noisiness and decay, rule-based role suggestions (kick, snare, hat, cymbal, other) with confidence and a plain-language reason, and loop length / tempo suggestions from a clip duration.
limits: Mono mix-down analysis; chops shorter than 5 ms or silent are classified as `other` with low confidence; suggestions never change project state
adapters: Pass decoded planar sample pointers wrapped in `SourceView`; apply accepted suggestions in your own role-assignment UI.
adapter_notes: Role names match the built-in role IDs of `chop_roles_grammar` but this module does not depend on it.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose Smart Setup suggestions only.
